items.title: 56712_Cootie Williams oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER: ...Monk's big number, 'Around Midnight', I mean, you had a hand in that, didn't you? INTERVIEWEE: Yeah.

ctx.x: Well, it's self-evident you did since you hired Bud Powell, and you hired Charlie Parker. And -- Monk never worked in the band did he?
No. If he did, he wasn't there for a long period of time.
